messages.en: Did you think you were the only adventurer in the dungeon? Well, you thought wrong! These unique adversaries often possess skills that normal monsters wouldn't, so be careful.
messages.zh: 你以为地牢里只有你一个冒险者吗？那可就想错了！这些独特的敌人往往拥有普通怪物不具备的能力，务必小心。

messages.context: Monster detail hints full paragraph
messages.en: The ghost of a deceased adventurer, it would like nothing better than to send you the same way.
messages.zh: 这是某位已故冒险者的鬼魂，它最想做的事莫过于送你去和它作伴。

messages.context: Monster detail hints full paragraph
messages.en: This monster appears to be really dangerous!
messages.zh: 这只怪物看起来极其危险！

messages.context: Monster detail hints full paragraph
messages.en: This monster appears to be quite dangerous.
messages.zh: 这只怪物看起来相当危险。

messages.context: Monster detail hints full paragraph
messages.en: A berserking monster is bloodthirsty and fighting madly. Such a blood rage makes it particularly dangerous!
messages.zh: 狂暴的怪物嗜血而疯狂地战斗。这种血怒会令它格外危险！

messages.context: Monster detail hints full paragraph
messages.en: Friendly monsters will follow you around and attempt to aid you in battle. You can order nearby allies by <w>t</w>alking to them.
messages.zh: 友善的怪物会跟随你，并在战斗中试图助你一臂之力。你可以通过与附近的盟友交谈来下达命令（按<w>t</w>）。

messages.context: Monster detail hints full paragraph
messages.en: However, it is only <w>temporarily</w> friendly, and will become dangerous again when this friendliness wears off.
messages.zh: 不过，它只是<w>暂时</w>对你友善；友善状态消退后，它又会变得危险。

messages.context: Monster detail hints full paragraph
messages.en: You can easily mark its square as dangerous to avoid accidentally entering into its field of view when using auto-explore or auto-travel. To do so, enter targeting mode with <w>x</w> and then press <w>e</w> when your cursor is hovering over the monster's grid. Doing so will mark this grid and all surrounding ones within a radius of 8 as "excluded" ones that explore or travel modes won't enter.
messages.zh: 你可以轻松地将它所在的格子标记为危险区域，避免使用自动探索或自动旅行时不慎进入它的视野。操作方法：按<w>x</w>进入瞄准模式，将光标移到怪物所在格后按<w>e</w>。这样会将该格及其半径8格范围内的所有格子标记为“排除”；自动探索和自动旅行不会进入这些格子。

messages.context: Monster detail hints full paragraph
messages.en: Apparently it has not noticed you - yet. Note that you do not have to engage every monster you meet. Sometimes, discretion is the better part of valour.
messages.zh: 它似乎还没发现你……至少目前如此。记住，你不必和遇到的每只怪物交战。有时，明哲保身才是上策。

messages.context: Monster detail hints full paragraph
messages.en: Apparently it has been distracted by something. You could use this opportunity to sneak up on this monster - or to sneak away.
messages.zh: 它似乎被什么东西分散了注意力。你可以趁机悄悄接近它，也可以悄悄离开。

messages.context: Monster detail hints full paragraph
messages.en: This monster doesn't appear to have any resistances or susceptibilities. It cannot fly and is of average speed. Examining other, possibly more high-level monsters can give important clues as to how to deal with them.
messages.zh: 这只怪物似乎没有任何抗性或弱点。它不能飞，速度也很普通。查看其他可能更强大的怪物，能帮助你找到应对它们的办法。

messages.context: Complete dangerous monster advice, alternative chosen semantically
messages.en: This might be a good time to run away.
messages.zh: 现在或许是逃跑的好时机。

messages.context: Complete dangerous monster advice, alternative chosen semantically
messages.en: This might be a good time to run away or apply your Berserk <w>a</w>bility.
messages.zh: 现在或许是逃跑或使用狂暴<w>a</w>能力的好时机。
